objective: Persist and reopen exact-scope core source observations, missing-data history and bounded human-only recheck proposals without dispatching providers or changing production.
non_goals: No source API call, automatic retry, live source hook, current shared change, production/ledger write, rights attestation, paid model, push, merge or rollout.
dependencies: Existing immutable EndpointSession catalogs and receipts
output_artifacts: Frozen source evidence and append-only gap events
Scoped health and human-only proposal view
acceptance_tests: Complete same-final offline CI and behavior mutation gate
Retained real receipt ingest and synthetic recovery demonstration
approval_gates: Any exact historical network recheck requires explicit new approval
Shared activation and production changes separately approved; two-human acceptance remains deferred
